tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: Discover and rank machine-accessible capabilities that may satisfy a natural-language request. Returns evidence, operational status, and ranking signals without executing a provider.

tools.name: compare_capabilities
tools.description: Ask Euvra to compare discovered providers for a request and select the strongest route candidate. This does not execute the provider.

tools.name: execute_capability
tools.description: Execute a real action using a live MCP provider selected by Euvra. Use discover_capabilities to find available capabilities and compare_capabilities to inspect route readiness before execution.
